question: What action leads to the practitioner becoming a yogin in this rite?
premises: It must then be placed on the head.
This act results in a future transformation of the practitioner.
inference: Therefore, by drawing it up and placing it on the head, the practitioner will become a yogin.
uncertainties: The object to be drawn up and placed is not explicitly stated in this verse.
plain_english: Having drawn it up and placed it on the head, one will then become a yogin.
